home.name: Jordan Goodwin
home.report: Goodwin won't return to Monday's game against the Warriors due to a left calf injury, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports. He recorded four points (2-3 FG, 0-1 3Pt), two rebounds, two assists and one steal in 10 minutes before exiting.

home.name: Mark Williams
home.report: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

away.name: Anthony Black
away.report: Black will be rested Monday against the Wizards.

away.name: Jonathan Isaac
away.report: Orlando recalled Isaac (knee) from the G League's Osceola Magic on Sunday.

away.name: Jalen Suggs
away.report: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

away.name: Paolo Banchero
away.report: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

away.name: Noah Penda
away.report: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

away.name: Izaiyah Nelson
away.report: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

home.name: Kristaps Porzingis

home.name: Moses Moody
home.report: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

home.name: Jimmy Butler III
home.report: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
